chapter.heading: A Song of Ascents; of Solomon.
chapter.v:
Except Jehovah
build the house,They labor in vain that build it:Except Jehovah keep the city,The watchman waketh but in vain.

It is
vain for you to rise up early,To take rest late,To eat the bread of toil;For so he giveth unto his beloved sleep.

Lo, children
are a heritage of Jehovah;And the fruit of the womb is his reward.

As arrows
in the hand of a mighty man,So are the children of youth.

Happy is
the man that hath his quiver full of them:They shall not be put to shame,When they speak with their enemies in the gate.
